game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek, a mossy forest creek: the druid must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Reverse Countdown: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek: a mossy forest creek
core_gameplay_loop: In Mossy Creek, repeat each round: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the launch_timing value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about launch_timing to power up the druid and open the heartwood tree.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Reverse Countdown
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how launch_timing changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Mossy Creek.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
